title: Chapter 342 Mr. Jiang Is Discharged From Hospital
content:
Chapter 342 Mr. Jiang Is Discharged From Hospital

Beep beep.

Time returns to normal.

Mr. Jiang, who was about to die, suddenly opened his eyes wide. The next moment, under the horrified gaze of several people around him, Mr. Jiang stood up from the hospital bed with a loud voice.

Ga~

In an instant, except for Lu Daosheng, all the people present opened their eyes wide and stared at Mr. Jiang at this time, with their mouths so wide that they could stuff a whole egg.

"Me, am I okay?"

"Hahaha, I'm fine, old man, I haven't been so comfortable for a long time!"

I don’t know how long it took, Mr. Jiang’s laughter came out, breaking the tranquility in the ward.

After a moment.

Several senior doctors surrounded Mr. Jiang for examinations inside and outside, and the faces were full of strange and shock.

"Doctor, how is my grandfather?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao stepped forward and asked, and at this moment, she was very nervous.

She was naturally extremely happy that her grandfather suddenly became lively.

However, she was afraid that her grandfather would be rebirth before her death.

She couldn't accept it even if she was so happy.

"I have been in a medical field for so many years, and this is the first time I have seen your grandfather in this situation."

A doctor sighed, wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.

The other doctor nodded too.

"The vital signs had almost disappeared the previous second, but the next second, such a shocking reversal happened. It's true,"

He didn't finish speaking, but the meaning was obvious.

This is simply impossible.

But now, it really happened, and it was right in front of him.

"So, my grandpa is fine?"

The stone in Jiang Xiaoxiao's heart fell down and her face was filled with a smile.

"Your grandpa is really fine now, but I still recommend that you continue to be hospitalized for a while."

The doctor spoke patiently.

He wasn't trying to make more hospitalization fees.

The main reason is that this matter is amazing.

But Jiang Xiaoxiao could not continue to listen, and at this moment she was only happy.

"Brother Sheng, grandpa is fine, grandpa is fine!"

Jiang Xiaoxiao ran to Lu Daosheng and was almost jumping up with Lu Daosheng in his arms.

But Lu Daosheng unconsciously took a step back.

"Okay, old man, he's fine. This is a good thing. Let's prepare to discharge the old man."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, then turned his head to look at the old man's attending doctor.

"This doctor, we don't need to continue to be hospitalized, we should prepare for discharge."

"But,,"

The doctor wanted to say something, but Lu Daosheng refused.

Just kidding, if you have yourself, what hospital is there?

Soon, Jiang Xiaoxiao took Lu Daosheng and Mr. Jiang back to the community where Jiang Xiaoxiao lived.

"Xiaoxiao, why do you live in such a place?"

Looking at the surrounding environment, Mr. Jiang frowned slightly.

Although their Jiang family is not as good as before, it is not so.

After all, I lived in a big villa before.

This is the first time that the old man has lived in such a place.

When Jiang Xiaoxiao heard his grandfather's words, she felt a little aggrieved.

"Grandpa, in the years when you are away, no one has taken care of the company, and it has already collapsed. I am still in school and I don't have much energy to take care of you, and I have to take care of you. Now there is not much money at home."

If she hadn't saved some money before, she wouldn't have a place to live here.

Jiang Xiaoxiao's words immediately made Mr. Jiang silent.

Unexpectedly, after three years of hospitalization, the family changed so much.

This reminded him of his son who died young. If he hadn't left, his family wouldn't have fallen to this point.

For a moment, the atmosphere suddenly became depressed.

And just then, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "The old man was discharged from the hospital today. Don't think about these things. With me here, the Jiang family will definitely rise again in the future."

Lu Daosheng's words also made the two of them temporarily restrain their sad faces.

"Grandpa, I'll cook for you. You must be hungry, right?"

"Well, indeed, hurry up and make it. Everything I eat now is delicious."

Lu Daosheng: "Then I'll go buy groceries."

Jiang Xiaoxiao: "Brother, let's go together."

After the two left, Mr. Jiang looked around, remained silent for a moment, and called.

"Hello?"

Soon, the phone was connected and an old voice came from the other side.

"It's me."

"You, Brother Jiang, you!"

"I've recovered."

Suddenly, the other side of the phone was silent for a long time.

"Really or not?"

"Ha, I'll lie to you."

"That's really good news. Tell me the address and I'll go see you in person tomorrow."

One hour later.

"Grandpa, we're back."

Lu Daosheng and Jiang Xiaoxiao walked in slowly with large bags of ingredients.

At this time, Mr. Jiang's face was very bad.

"If I don't come back, I will be starved to death by you even if I don't die."

"Grandpa, don't worry, I'll cook for you now."

Seeing that his grandfather was starving, Jiang Xiaoxiao hurriedly ran into the kitchen with her things.

Lu Daosheng originally wanted to help, but Old Master Jiang grabbed him.

"Xiaosen, come here."

The two entered a bedroom.

"Xiaosen, you treated my disease, right?"

Mr. Jiang looked at Lu Daosheng with a heavy expression.

"yes."

Lu Daosheng did not hide this.

When he saw Lu Daosheng, he admitted generously that even though Mr. Jiang had already made mental preparations, he was still shocked.

"You haven't seen each other for eight years, but you've gained abilities."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Old Master Jiang smiled helplessly.

"Don't you want to tell me anything?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked at Mr. Jiang seriously, "Mr., you just need to know that I will not harm you."

Looking at Lu Daosheng's face, Old Master Jiang suddenly had a lot of thoughts.

The once sloppy little kid can now really stand alone.

He has not asked about Lu Daosheng's experience in the past eight years.

He just needs to know that Lu Daosheng is back.

Another half an hour later, a large table of dishes was prepared.

Because time is tight, Jiang Xiaoxiao is afraid that his grandfather will be hungry, so she didn't make much time-consuming and labor-intensive dishes.

But even so, these dishes are still full of colors, fragrance and flavor.

Soon, Mr. Jiang started to have a feast.

Neither Lu Daosheng nor Jiang Xiaoxiao moved his chopsticks, but just stared at the old man in his seventies in front of him, as if he hadn't eaten for eight hundred years, and he tried his best to stuff it into his mouth.

I didn't even take any food to see.

"Grandpa, please wait, don't choke."

Jiang Xiaoxiao said weakly.

On the side, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and said with a smile: "Master, do you want to have two cups?"

Hearing this, Mr. Jiang's actions of eating suddenly stopped. He looked at Lu Daosheng with a light in his eyes.
